Norm.ShopDialogue.01: Welcome to Norm's! Good for what ails ya.
Norm.ShopDialogue.02: I've got a pretzel with your name on it, ${mister^miss^friend}$.
Norm.ShopDialogue.03: Don't forget to buy a nice, cold drink, too!
Norm.ShopDialogue.04: Can I interest you in any of my delicious pies?
Norm.ShopDialogue.05: Pick whatever you like. Everything's delicious.
Norm.ShopDialogue.06: I know just what you need: [ArticleFor [SuggestedItem]] [SuggestedItem]!
Norm.ShopDialogue.07: The best things in life are edible.
Norm.FairShopDialogue.01: I take star tokens as a condition for serving food here. I cash 'em out later.
Norm.FairShopDialogue.02: Nothing like a warm pretzel on a cool autumn day.
Norm.FairShopDialogue.03: I bet you could use a drink!
